evidence.testTitle: matrix identity AUTH-005 AUTH-006 AUTH-007 AUTH-011 AUTH-012 AUTH-013 AUTH-022: independent credentials and device logout
evidence.scenarioScope: Independent login credentials and logout of only the selected session.
evidence.rationale: Only the listed source-verified assertions are credited; all other dimensions remain required and uncovered unless another matched test covers them.
assertionDetails: Second login has a distinct token but the same account ID; Alice and Bob account IDs differ.
Wrong-password and unknown-user login each return 401 and no token field.
Logging out Alice’s first session returns 200; that token gets 401 on profile read while her second token and Bob’s token still get 200.

evidence.testTitle: matrix identity USER-001 USER-002 USER-003 USER-004 USER-005 USER-006 USER-012 USER-013 USER-014: profile path and body identity are bound to session
evidence.scenarioScope: Profile path/body identity binding, protected fields and persisted state.
evidence.rationale: Only the listed source-verified assertions are credited; all other dimensions remain required and uncovered unless another matched test covers them.
assertionDetails: Bob establishes a profile baseline; Alice PATCH to Bob’s profile with conflicting query, body username and x-user header returns 403 and Bob remains unchanged.
Alice own-profile PATCH succeeds despite a body username and privileged role fields; readback contains the requested display name and not admin role.
Bob remains unchanged; Alice is denied admin account listing while root is allowed.
After stopping the runtime, user_metadata contains the authorized Alice and Bob values and excludes the denied value.

evidence.testTitle: matrix authentication transports AUTH-014 AUTH-015: NickServ and SASL resolve the REST account principal
evidence.scenarioScope: NickServ IDENTIFY and SASL PLAIN principal binding.
evidence.rationale: Only the listed source-verified assertions are credited; all other dimensions remain required and uncovered unless another matched test covers them.
assertionDetails: Bob IRC connection identifies as Alice using NickServ and receives numeric 900 for Alice.

evidence.testTitle: matrix expired and unauthenticated access AUTH-001 AUTH-002 AUTH-003 AUTH-004: IRC NICK and USER alone cannot join or send messages
evidence.scenarioScope: Unauthenticated IRC registration, JOIN and PRIVMSG denial.
evidence.rationale: Only the listed source-verified assertions are credited; all other dimensions remain required and uncovered unless another matched test covers them.
assertionDetails: Guest sends NICK/USER, JOIN, channel PRIVMSG and DM PRIVMSG then PING barrier; test observes no numeric 001 or JOIN and observes numeric 451.
